about: Every image and film the site uses. Each is uploaded to Cloudinary as daniekeys-site/<name>. The sha256 and bytes are the exact file used in the Claude Design canvas (Daniekeys Studios Website UI), so `node scripts/media.mjs find <folders>` can locate the same file on disk. Originals of the films may be larger versions with a different hash; the hint says what each one is so it can be picked by eye.
